nom: No7 Lift & Luminate Triple Action Serum

segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin, including one with dry and sensitive skin, report the serum leaves skin smooth and supple without flaking, with dark spots and fine lines also fading with continued use.
segments.oily: One reviewer with oily skin reports the serum leaves a matte finish without adding extra sebum, alongside firmer, plumper skin and reduced redness.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with dry, sensitive skin and one who is allergic to many face products both report the serum was gentle and non-irritating, with no breakouts or flare-ups.

concerns.aging: Most reviewers report visibly reduced fine lines and wrinkles within one to two weeks of daily use, including fading around the eyes, forehead and neck; however, two reviewers report seeing little to no reduction in their fine lines despite continued use.
concerns.dehydration: Reviewers overwhelmingly report the serum hydrates without flaking or dryness, including on dry skin overnight; one reviewer, however, reports the serum caused a little skin dryness.
concerns.redness: Two reviewers report the serum reduced visible redness and evened out skin tone, including one whose redness stemmed from allergies.
concerns.spots: Several reviewers report dark spots fading or disappearing within one to two weeks; one reviewer, however, reports no improvement in her melasma or sunspots despite seeing her wrinkles improve.
concerns.blemishes: Reviewers report the serum did not cause breakouts, including one allergic to many face products, and one reports her skin looks clearer with fewer blemishes.

aspects.libelle: Strong perfume scent bothers some users
Comes in a squeeze tube, not a dropper
Good value for a drugstore serum

extraits.titre: More like an ointment than a Serum
extraits.texte: Every serum I've ever used comes with a dropper and is super light and easy to spread on my skin. Thus, I was disappointed with my first use. This "serum" comes in a tube and is super thick, like petroleum jelly. But it dries very quickly, so you can only use a little at a time. I found that it works best by applying directly to my wrinkles and fine lines and then just rubbing it in. If you use too much, it will come off like little balls in your hands. It has a very strong perfumey scent that I don't like. Buttttt, after using this product for 2 weeks I have started to notice that my forehead wrinkles are much less noticeable! Unfortunately, it hasn't done anything for my melasma and sunspots. So as you can see I have very mixed feelings regarding this product. It is more like an ointment than what I would consider a serum. I think they should have marketed it as a wrinkle spot treatment instead.

I've been using this product for about 2 weeks in the morning, it's been great for my very dry skin. I've noticed a more smooth silky texture to my skin and I feel it has helped the dark spots I have targeted. Love the consistency of the product and it's at a great price point.
Very soothing serum for the face. Using for 4 days my skin was soft and luminous. However the serum caused a little skin dryness.

I love No 7 Lift & Luminate Triple Action Serum. It is a lightweight serum that absorbs quickly and there is no tacky after feel. My skin feels satiny smooth and nicely hydrated after using it. It has a very pleasant scent as well. I have noticed my skin tone has evened with less red areas and it has brightened in appearance. My skin feels firm and plump which lessens the fine lines around my eyes. I have oily skin and this serum leaves a matte feel and does not produce extra sebum. This has become my favorite serum. I have noticed real results from the first use and I highly recommend it.

extraits.titre: Improves skin with only a few uses!
extraits.texte: I received a free sample of this product, and found I loved how the No7 Lift & Luminate Triple Action Serum seemed to work wonders on my dry skin with only a few morning and evening applications. I smoothed this serum on my face and along my neck after cleansing every morning, and then added my usual moisturizer and sunscreen over it. I then made sure to use it in the evenings when winding down with my nightly routine after cleansing and before adding my night cream. I noticed soon after using (maybe a day or two) that my skin felt more supple and younger. Since my skin is usually dry, I was glad to notice no flaking away of skin cells or rough dry spots after using this serum. I don't currently have many visible wrinkles, but I was impressed by the way this seemed to eliminate the fine lines around my eyes and mouth. I would recommend this product for aging skincare.
I am allergic to a lot of face products. I was weary a out trying this but, I am glad that I did. I have not had any break out and my face looks great. My new favorite product.
Great serum for dry, sensitive skin. I have some redness from allergies and this really helped even out my skin tone.
